01 - Who We Are

Data Controller: SocialJam S.L., a company incorporated in Spain, is the data controller responsible for your personal data when you use the skeep app.

skeep is a mobile-first social gaming application that lets users discover and play turn-based games, challenge friends, and communicate via messaging and group chats. Given the social and interactive nature of our Service, we collect and process certain personal data to provide and improve these features.

Our registered address is: SocialJam S.L., Carrer de Ramón Llull 2, 1r 2a, 08923 Santa Coloma de Gramenet, Spain. You can reach our privacy team at hi@skeep.me.

We collect data in three ways: data you provide directly, data generated by your use of the Service, and data received from third parties.

DataWhen collectedNotes

If you sign in using a third-party service (e.g. Apple Sign In or Google Sign In), we receive basic profile data from that provider, subject to their own privacy policies. We may also receive aggregated analytics or fraud-detection signals from our service partners.

03 - How We Use Your Data

We use the data we collect for the following purposes:

  • Providing the Service — creating and managing your account, enabling gameplay, matchmaking, messaging, and group chats
  • Personalisation — tailoring your game feed, recommending challenges, and displaying relevant content based on your activity
  • Safety & moderation — reviewing reported content, investigating abuse, enforcing our Terms & Conditions, and protecting users from harm
  • Security & fraud prevention — detecting and preventing cheating, account takeovers, and other malicious activity
  • Communications — sending service-related notifications and, where you have opted in, promotional messages
  • Analytics & improvement — understanding how users interact with the app to fix bugs, improve features, and develop new ones
  • Advertising — serving ads to free-tier users, and measuring ad performance (see Section 6)
  • Legal compliance — meeting our obligations under applicable law

Messages & Chat Data

Messages are stored to deliver them reliably and to enable our safety team to review content when a report is filed. We do not routinely read private messages. Automated systems may scan messages to detect spam, illegal content, or policy violations.

04 - Legal Bases for Processing

As a company based in Spain, we process personal data of users in the European Economic Area (EEA) under the GDPR. We rely on the following legal bases:

Legal BasisWhen we rely on it
Contract performanceProcessing necessary to provide the Service (account creation, gameplay, messaging)
Legitimate interestsAnalytics, fraud prevention, security, service improvement, and direct marketing to existing users
ConsentPersonalised advertising (where required by law); optional push notifications; processing of data for users under 16
Legal obligationCompliance with applicable laws, regulatory requests, and court orders
Your right to withdraw consent

Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it at any time through your in-app settings or by contacting us. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of prior processing.

05 - Sharing Your Data

We do not sell your personal data. We may share it only in the following circumstances:

With Other Users

Your username, display name, profile picture, and game stats are visible to other skeep users. Messages you send are visible to the recipient(s). Your friends list may be visible depending on your privacy settings.

With Service Providers

We work with trusted third-party companies to help operate the Service, including cloud hosting, analytics, customer support, payment processors, and moderation services. These providers process data only on our behalf under strict data processing agreements.

With Advertising Partners

For free-tier users, we share limited data with advertising networks to serve and measure ads. See Section 6 for more detail and opt-out options.

For Legal Reasons

We may disclose your data if required by law, regulation, or valid legal process; to protect the rights, safety, or property of SocialJam S.L., our users, or the public; or in connection with a corporate transaction such as a merger or acquisition.

Important

We will never sell, rent, or trade your personal data to third parties for their own marketing purposes.

06 - Advertising & Tracking

Free-tier users see ads within the skeep app. We use third-party advertising networks that may use cookies, device identifiers, and similar technologies to serve relevant ads.

What Data Is Used for Ads

  • Device advertising identifier (IDFA on iOS, GAID on Android), where permitted
  • General location derived from IP address
  • In-app activity and usage patterns
  • Device type and operating system

Your Choices

  • iOS: Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking
  • Android: Settings → Google → Ads → Opt out of Ads Personalisation
  • In-app: Account settings → Ad preferences
  • Premium subscription: Removes all advertising entirely

Analytics

We use analytics tools to understand engagement. Analytics data is aggregated and used only to improve the Service. You can opt out in your account settings.

We comply with Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) framework and Google's advertising policies. We will always request your permission before tracking your activity across other apps and websites.

07 - Data Retention

We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as necessary to provide the Service.

Data TypeRetention Period
Account dataUntil account deletion, plus 30 days for recovery
Profile pictureUntil removed or account deletion
Messages & group chat contentUp to 12 months, or until deleted by user
Games played & statsDuration of account; anonymised aggregates retained indefinitely
Log & device dataUp to 90 days
Financial transaction records7 years (Spanish tax law)
Safety & moderation recordsUp to 3 years after the incident is resolved

After the retention period, data is securely deleted or anonymised. Some data may be retained longer if required by law or to resolve disputes.

08 - Data Security

We implement industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including:

  • Encryption of data in transit using TLS
  • Encryption of sensitive data at rest
  • Access controls limiting data to authorised personnel
  • Regular security assessments and penetration testing
  • Incident response procedures for data breaches
No system is 100% secure

While we strive to protect your data, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure. In the event of a breach, we will notify you and the relevant supervisory authority as required by applicable law.

You are also responsible for keeping your account credentials secure. Do not share your password with anyone.

09 - Children's Privacy

skeep is intended for users aged 13 and above. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If we become aware of such data, we will delete it promptly.

For users aged 13 to 15 in the EEA, we require verifiable parental or guardian consent before processing their personal data beyond what is strictly necessary. Certain features — including personalised advertising — are restricted for users under 16.

If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal data without your consent, please contact us at hi@skeep.me.

10 - Your Rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data. We honour these rights for all users where technically feasible.

RightWhat it means
AccessRequest a copy of the personal data we hold about you
RectificationRequest correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
ErasureRequest deletion of your data, subject to legal retention obligations
RestrictionRequest that we limit processing in certain circumstances
PortabilityReceive your data in a machine-readable format
ObjectionObject to processing based on legitimate interests or for direct marketing
Withdraw consentWithdraw consent at any time without affecting prior processing
ComplaintLodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Spain: AEPD — aepd.es)

How to Exercise Your Rights

Use your in-app account settings (Settings → Privacy) or contact us at hi@skeep.me. We respond within 30 days and may verify your identity before acting.

California Residents (CCPA / CPRA)

California residents have additional rights including the right to know, right to delete, right to opt out of sale (we do not sell data), and right to non-discrimination. Contact hi@skeep.me.

Account deletion

Delete your account at any time from Settings → Account → Delete Account. This initiates permanent deletion in accordance with Section 7 retention periods.

11 - International Transfers

SocialJam S.L. is based in Spain and primarily processes data within the EEA. However, some service providers and advertising partners are located outside the EEA, including in the United States.

When we transfer personal data outside the EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, including:

  • Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) approved by the European Commission
  • Transfers to countries with an EU adequacy decision
  • Other lawful mechanisms under GDPR Chapter V

Contact us at hi@skeep.me for more information about specific safeguards.

12 - Third-Party Links & Services

The skeep app may contain links to third-party websites or services. This Privacy Policy applies only to the skeep Service. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of any third party, and we encourage you to review their policies.

If you connect a third-party account (e.g. Sign in with Apple or Google), your use of that service is governed by its own privacy policy. We receive only the data you authorise that service to share with us.

13 - Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make material changes, we will notify you by:

  • Displaying a prominent in-app notice
  • Sending an email to your registered address, and/or
  • Updating the "Effective Date" at the top of this document

Your continued use of skeep after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the revised policy. If you do not agree, you may delete your account before changes take effect.
